purpose: Current MediaMuster Frame Rate source-to-presentation review and whether Bella can share its agreed SampleRate/Duration value and interpreter.
status: Research completed. Frame Rate source, numeric sorting, late formatting and shared-helper naming remain proposals, not approved runtime implementation.

scope.method: Fresh read-only source trace with two independent peer reviews; existing curated native/corpus evidence consulted.

currentBehavior.mdbOwner: Physical file mob own referenced descriptor; not selected master or project editing rate.
currentBehavior.wire: Complete eight-byte omfi:Rational or omfi:ExactEditRate; two signed32 words in established object byte order.
currentBehavior.validation: Readable unique property, positive numerator and denominator within signed32 range.
currentBehavior.videoProjection: Own MDFL:SampleRate supplies Frame Rate and is also paired with own MDFL:Length for Duration. The recorded fraction is used literally in current MDB timing.
currentBehavior.compressionCaveat: legacyDnxNamingRate has narrowly qualified naming-only aliases and explicitly leaves recorded Frame Rate/Duration unchanged. Preserve approved Compression system.
currentBehavior.priority: When available and eligible, current MXF/OMF tier is preferred over MDB Frame Rate.
currentBehavior.headerScheduling: Missing video Frame Rate is itself one missing required field that can cause a header read; complete usable database match can skip header.
currentBehavior.rowStorage: Original MediaRate numerator/denominator plus eager QString label; Duration retains its own rate copy.
currentBehavior.label: Fraction to double, fixed three decimal places, trailing zeros then trailing decimal point removed.
currentBehavior.sort: Parse rounded label to double; use text tie breaker. Original exact fraction is not the Frame Rate sort key.
currentBehavior.sourceAgreement: Raw exact cross-product comparison recognizes unreduced equivalent fractions, but does not equate typed Avid decimal aliases with corresponding 1001-based rational.

proposedBellaReuse.alreadyApproved: Preserve own Length and SampleRate, apply verified scoped Avid video interpretation before exact Duration arithmetic; concrete audio frequency sources stay separate; audio Frame Rate blank.
proposedBellaReuse.oneVideoRate: Use same selected physical video descriptor SampleRate for Frame Rate and Duration; preserve original pair and typed meaning once, derive exact semantic rate as needed.
proposedBellaReuse.sharedInterpreter: The existing provisional AvidDurationInterpreter conversion can be a shared pure video-rate helper; AvidVideoRateInterpreter is proposed clearer naming, not an implemented/native class.
proposedBellaReuse.formatting: Generate familiar Frame Rate label at presentation without retaining only rounded text or parsing text back for calculations.
proposedBellaReuse.numericSort: Compare interpreted numeric rates exactly within supported representation; keep raw metadata separately. Unusual-rate precision and unavailable placement require final presentation agreement.
proposedBellaReuse.audio: Share small numeric/availability/formatting building blocks as appropriate, but retain class-specific concrete sampling source and omit video NTSC aliases. Internal audio Duration frame clock does not populate visible Frame Rate.
proposedBellaReuse.timecode: Nominal 24/30 bases and recorded drop-frame affect Duration numbering only, not FPS or Frame Rate label.
proposedBellaReuse.io: Deriving video Frame Rate from already selected MDB rate needs no second rate lookup or media read solely for that label. This does not approve global MDB-only Frame Rate or header priorities.
proposedBellaReuse.noUnmeasuredClaims: No measured scan-speed, memory, installed-app behavior or comparative benchmark claim.
